description: This file defines the LeaveRequestCommentService class, which provides a service layer for handling leave request comments within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes a method for retrieving a DAO object used for database operations related to leave request comments.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentService
classes.description: Service class providing access to leave request comment data operations, manages DAO instantiation.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentDao
methods.description: Retrieves or instantiates the LeaveRequestCommentDao object used for database interactions related to leave request comments.
